policies.text: Policy: overtime is paid at 1.5 times the hourly rate for hours above 40 in a week.
Policy: account executives earn 8% commission on quarterly bookings above the 50,000 dollar quota.
Policy: mileage is reimbursed at 0.70 dollars per mile; the first 30 miles of each monthly log are commuting and not reimbursed.
Policy: overdue invoices carry a late fee of 0.05% of the invoice per day overdue, after a 10-day grace period.

system: You are the bookkeeping assistant of Quillhaven Bookkeeping, a small firm. Use the remembered records. For any amount, call the matching workflow tool; do not do the arithmetic yourself. End with one line 'Answer: <amount in dollars>' (0 if nothing is due) or 'Answer: No record'.

bare.long: The tools as the team's custom GPT had them: parameter names and a one-line description; MemoryRouter attaches the records and the policies

nopolicy.long: The same bare tools, but the boundary covers only the records project: the policies are not in the memory the model sees (the control)

described.long: Each parameter description says TOTAL, exactly as recorded, and that the tool applies the threshold itself (never subtract it yourself)

record.long: The tools take a record id (and, for what-if questions, the change) and read the recorded value from typed memory themselves

claude_bare.long: The same workflow memory, read by a second model: claude-haiku-4-5 with the bare tools, records + policies
